hunks.baseline: A simple mountain man, Jang-pal felt terribly sorry for the old man.
hunks.sol: Jang-pal was a simple mountain man, and he felt terribly sorry for the old man.

hunks.baseline: He had lived his entire life without anything holding him back. Everyone had feared and revered him. Even the renowned masters of Murim had tucked their tails between their legs in his presence.
hunks.sol: He had lived his whole life without a single thing to fear. Everyone had feared and revered him. Even the renowned masters of Murim had tucked their tails between their legs in his presence.

hunks.baseline: When he looked down, he saw chubby baby fat quivering in motion.
hunks.sol: When he looked down, he saw chubby baby fat quivering.

hunks.baseline: Just as she said, the food was simple: a few kinds of namul and mixed-grain rice. The meat soup they had served to make the meal more special was pale and bland.
hunks.sol: Just as she said, the food was simple: a few kinds of namul and mixed-grain rice. The meat soup they had brought out to be hospitable was watery and bland.

hunks.baseline: Hanga, unaware of that, continued chattering excitedly.
hunks.sol: Hanga, meanwhile, unaware of that, kept chattering excitedly.

hunks.sol: “I’ll make you the greatest divine weapon in the world.”

hunks.baseline: “Is all of that Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron?”
When Jang Taebo had shown no reaction after hearing that I possessed Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, I had assumed that people in the upper circles treated Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron as basic gear.
hunks.sol: When Jang Taebo had shown no reaction after hearing that I possessed Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron, I had figured the big shots up top treated Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron as basic gear.

hunks.baseline: It meant I could rely on my gear to give me a head start.
hunks.sol: It meant I got a head start just from my gear.

hunks.baseline: It was hard to believe he was the same old man who had been so indifferent and dismissive only moments ago. Of course, I was happy things had worked out.
hunks.sol: It was hard to believe he was the same old man who had been so indifferent and dismissive only moments ago. Of course, it worked out in my favor, so I was happy.
